fullPassage: There is a wealth of evidence that when parents, teachers, supervisors, and coaches are perceived as involved and caring, people feel happier and more motivated. And it is not just those people with power — we need to feel valued and respected by peers and coworkers. Thus, when the need for relatedness is met, motivation and internalization are fueled, provided that support for autonomy and competence are also there. If we are trying to motivate others, a caring relationship is a crucial basis from which to begin. And when we are trying to motivate ourselves, doing things to enhance a sense of connectedness to others can be crucial to long-term persistence. So exercise with a friend, call someone when you have a difficult decision to make, and be there as a support for others as they take on challenges.

questions.passage: There is a wealth of evidence that when parents, teachers, supervisors, and coaches are perceived as involved and caring, people feel happier and more motivated. And it is not just <u>those</u> people with power — we need to feel valued and respected by peers and coworkers. Thus, when the need for relatedness is met, motivation and internalization are fueled, provided that support for autonomy and competence are also there. If we are trying to motivate others, a caring relationship is a crucial basis from which to begin. And when we are trying to motivate ourselves, doing things to enhance a sense of connectedness to others can be crucial to long-term persistence. So exercise with a friend, call someone when you have a difficult decision to make, and be there as a support for others as they take on challenges.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 those가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'it is not just those people with power' — those people with power는 권력을 가진 사람들을 가리킴.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 행복하고 동기부여된 사람들 — 결과이지 지칭 대상 아님
✅ ② 권력을 가진 사람들 — those people with power 직접 지칭
❌ ③ 동료들 — those와 대비되는 개념
❌ ④ 배려하는 사람들 — 전체적 설명이지 those의 지칭 아님
det.tip: 지칭추론: those가 포함된 구 'those people with power'를 그대로 해석하면 정답 도출
